description:
Add appropriate input types for mobile keyboards (email, tel, number), implement auto-complete support, add floating labels, and create custom date/number pickers that use native mobile interfaces.

**Rationale:** Poor form experiences cause 21% mobile form abandonment. Native keyboard types and pickers reduce typing effort and validation errors.
title: Mobile-Optimized Form Inputs
